title: fix(console): a settings action whose handler declares confirmText asks before invoking

Fixes #30419

Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:设置页的操作按钮(`action_button`)若在 manifest 里声明了 `confirmText`,点击后先弹出确认框显示该文字;取消则什么都不执行,确认才执行一次。未声明的按钮行为不变。
- 为什么改:spec 早已声明「执行前确认」(`SpecifierHandlerSchema` 的 `http` / `action` 两臂),但控制台从不读取,作者标记为需确认的危险操作一点就跑(声明 ≠ 兑现)。
- 风险与回滚:仅改控制台一个渲染分支,复用现有 `AlertDialog` 原语与已有 `actionConfirm.*` 文案键,不加新组件、不加新 locale 键;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/SettingsField.tsx` 的 `action_button` 分支(`declaredConfirm` 一段);其次新测试 `SettingsField.actionConfirm.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/settings/__tests__/SettingsField.actionConfirm.test.tsx`,预期 11 passed。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `SettingsField`'s `action_button` row reads the handler's declared `confirmText` (the spec's `SpecifierHandlerSchema` `http` / `action` arms: "Confirm dialog text before invoking (omit = no confirm)").
- Declared (judged `confirmText != null`, the same test the spec's action resolver applies when it decides an action opens a dialog): the button becomes the trigger of the console's existing `AlertDialog` primitive from `@object-ui/components` (the one the Approvals Inbox confirms with). The dialog body is the text resolved the way this file resolves the row's other manifest copy: `labels.actionConfirm(actionId, resolveLabel(confirmText))`, i.e. the already-existing, until now unread `settings.NAMESPACE.actions.ID.confirmText` slot with the manifest literal as fallback. Title / Cancel / Continue reuse the shared `actionConfirm.*` keys `ActionConfirmDialog` uses, so no locale key is added. Cancel invokes nothing; Continue invokes `onAction` once.
- Not declared, and a `navigate` handler (which has no such key): the button is rendered exactly as before, `onClick={onAction}`, no dialog.
- Outside the source-badge / reset-to-default region; no `packages/**` change; no change to the `types.ts` mirror.

## Tests

New `ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/__tests__/SettingsField.actionConfirm.test.tsx` (11 tests):
- for an `http` and an `action` handler with `confirmText`: click opens an alertdialog carrying the text and invokes nothing; Cancel closes it and invokes nothing; Continue invokes exactly once;
- the `actions.ID.confirmText` translation is what the dialog shows, and the helper is asked with the manifest literal as fallback;
- no `confirmText` (`http`, `action`), a `navigate` handler, and no handler: click invokes once, no dialog.

## Acceptance notes

- The settings mirror (`types.ts`) types `confirmText` as a plain string while the spec declares an `I18nLabel` (string or inline locale map). The same mirror gap already holds for every specifier `label` here (`resolveLabel` reads a string or a `defaultValue`/`key` object, not an inline locale map). This PR keeps that resolution unchanged; because the dialog opens on the declaration, not on the resolved text, an inline-map `confirmText` still asks (with the generic title) rather than running unasked. Not filed: observation, no reach measured.
